verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) query the cap table in plain English, which is a form of agent-facing interface, but it is explicitly read-only (no write/drive actions) and no general public REST/OpenAPI API is documented — openapi.json/swagger.json probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented public API for write/action operations, OpenAPI/swagger spec, and evidence of actually driving (not just querying) the product via API.
